basic_info.description: Well maintained Richmond District flats. Located near Golden Gate Park and George Washington High School with public transportation at your doorsteps. There is an in-law apartment. The spacious garage has side-by-side parking with plenty of storage. The washer/dryer in the garage serves all units. There is an eating area off the gas kitchens. Each unit has a fireplace (condition not known). The upper unit has a view of the Pacific Ocean from the back bedrooms. Hardwood floors throughout both units.
